title: Rebuild routing decision context and fallback backpressure
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: The current smart-router decision path combines policy evaluation, route scoring, and fallback selection in a single hotpath. This has accumulated several ad-hoc optimizations and regional special-cases that make reasoning, testing, and performance tuning difficult. We see frequent mutex contention on the routing context, coupled with increased P99 tail latency during bursty traffic to specific regions.

Goal: Rebuild the routing decision context and extract fallback/backpressure logic off the synchronous request hotpath. Deliverables include: a compact DecisionContext V2 (immutable snapshot per request), a tiny policy expression IR and evaluator (precompiled), a non-blocking async Fallback Coordinator with rate-aware backpressure, and a per-region lease cache to eliminate cross-region locks.

Approach:
- Introduce DecisionContext V2: immutable struct constructed once per request before kernel-level routing. Move temporary mutation (score accumulation, transient traces) into a local mutable buffer that is serialized at the end.
- Policy expression IR: compile policy rules into a lightweight bytecode during config deploy. Replace the legacy regex/AST evaluator with a tiny VM that runs in ~200ns on common cases.
- Fallback Coordinator: decouple fallback selection from main route evaluation. The hotpath will record 'fallback-candidates' and the coordinator will select and activate fallbacks asynchronously, using token buckets to avoid cascade failover storms.
- Region lease cache: per-region ephemeral leases for affinity/preferred routing that refresh asynchronously to prevent global locks.
- Route-score normalization: move from float64 scoring to normalized int16 scores with attached histogram buckets to reduce garbage and branch mispredictions.

Success criteria / Acceptance:
- End-to-end p50 routing latency on happy-path reduced by >= 12% in staging for 95th percentile request sizes.
- P99 tail latency reduced by >= 20% under bursty regional load (synthetic tests).
- No increase in error-rate or incorrect fallbacks in regression suite (existing route invariants pass).
- New metrics in Console: fallback.activation.rate, fallback.backpressure.events, routing.decision_context.allocs.

Rollout plan: Canary on runtime-1.22 in us-west-2 for 48h (5% traffic), promote to 25% for 24h if stable, full rollout if thresholds met. Automatic rollback triggers: >2x increase in p99 or >0.5% customer-visible errors in canary window.

Related artifacts: Confluence design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Routing/decision-context-v2, PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/5123, benchmark notebook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-routing-bench-DCV2
comments: 2026-02-20 - Aisha Patel: Initial spike completed. Prototype DecisionContext V2 slice-compatible; synthetic microbench shows 18% allocation reduction. Recording notes in Confluence. Decided to use int16 normalized scores after microbenching float vs int on x86 and A100.

2026-02-25 - Diego Morales: Converted two hot-path callers to build DecisionContext V2; observed 8% p50 improvement in local loadtests. Left TODOs: feature flags, metric hooks, and small allocation in policy evaluator still present.

2026-03-02 - Linnea Johansson (SRE review): Load test with regional burst pattern shows p99 improvement but noticed transient spike when coordinator first activates fallback due to cold caches. Plan: pre-warm per-region lease cache during coordinator startup and instrument warmup metric.

2026-03-05 - Diego Morales: Implemented async Fallback Coordinator and token-bucket backpressure. Added metric fallback.backpressure.events and bounding behavior for simultaneous fallbacks. PR uploaded: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/5123 (WIP).

2026-03-08 - Samuel Green (security): Reviewed for possible timing side-channels in policy VM. Recommend constant-time comparison for sensitive attributes and flagging policies with identity-scoped conditions for an optional hardened mode. Marked security_review_required = true for the hardened mode rollout.

2026-03-10 - Diego Morales: Canary started in us-west-2 (5%). Early telemetry: routing.decision_context.allocs down 22%, fallback.activation.rate stable. One rollback-trigger-level p99 spike at 02:14 UTC correlated with an external cache outage; handled via automatic fallback to legacy path. Investigating graceful degrade path.
